personality.name: The Contrarian Seed VC

communication_style.directness: Very direct; cuts through narrative quickly
communication_style.listening_style: Listens for contradictions between story and numbers

typical_question_patterns: What do you believe that smart people disagree with?
Walk me through CAC and payback with real assumptions
what_impresses_them: Specific customer stories with dates and outcomes
Founders who changed their mind from data
behavioral_signals: Leans back when hearing generic vision
Asks 'what would kill this company?' mid-pitch

fundraising: Is this a vitamin or a painkiller?
Can this team survive 18 months on this round?
negotiation: Why this valuation is justified by milestones

source_citations.communication_style: Archetype: composite of public seed investor interview patterns
